To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hierarchical graphical face model is an effective tool for designing feature set for automatic age estimation.

(i) we propose a hierarchical face model to guide the extraction of features for age estimation; (ii) the features extracted from the hierarchical face model are effective for age estimation; and (iii) the presented method is flexible and easy to extend.
We present an effective feature set for age regression using hierarchical face model, which is proved by the experimental results on two age estimation datasets.
